show_icon.label: Show the mouse icon
show_icon.description: Draw a mouse glyph before the values. It turns into a warning sign when the battery is low.

show_battery.label: Show the battery level
show_battery.description: The battery percentage, coloured by the thresholds below.

show_charging.label: Show when charging
show_charging.description: A bolt while the mouse is charging, whether or not the percentage is shown.

interval.label: Read interval (seconds)
interval.description: Seconds between reads from the mouse. Each read sends about 60 small requests over the wireless link.

battery_warn.label: Battery warning level (%)
battery_warn.description: At or below this percentage the battery is shown in amber.

battery_low.label: Battery low level (%)
battery_low.description: At or below this percentage the battery is shown in the theme's error colour. If it is at or above the warning level, there is no amber band.

bar_device.label: Device in the bar
bar_device.description: Which device the bar shows: part of its name (e.g. PRO X) or its unit ID, as the panel lists it. Leave empty to show the first online device with a battery.

panel.dpi_asleep: Move the mouse to wake it before changing the DPI
panel.onboard_note: The mouse's stored profile sets the report rate. Host mode lets you change it here, and turns the profile (its buttons, DPI levels and lighting) off until you switch back.
panel.host_note: The onboard profile is off: its buttons, DPI levels and lighting return when you switch back.
